shortDescription: Delhi High Court JJA / Restorer Revised Result 2026 and Mains Exam Date. The mains examination is scheduled for 04 October 2026 for the 152-post recruitment.
content:
High Court of Delhi, New Delhi has released the Junior Judicial Assistant (JJA) / Restorer Revised Result 2026 and mains examination date notice. Candidates enrolled in the 152-post recruitment can check the revised result through the official Digialm portal.

Important dates

  • Application period: 04 February to 23 February 2026
  • Preliminary CBT: 22 March 2026
  • Answer key: 24 March 2026
  • Result: 25 April 2026
  • Mains examination: 04 October 2026

Vacancy and eligibility

The recruitment includes 152 Junior Judicial Assistant / Restorer posts. Applicants were required to hold a bachelor's degree from a recognized university and have computer typing speed of 30 words per minute.

Download the revised result from the login link and read the official mains notice carefully for examination instructions, schedule and admit card updates.
